name: Rajan Adhikari
heroIntro: I build businesses rooted in the Himalayas — guiding travelers across Nepal's greatest trails, running a modern barbershop, and growing an imports venture from Kathmandu.
about:
I'm Rajan Adhikari, a Nepal-based entrepreneur. Over the years I've turned a love for the mountains into a trekking and expeditions company, opened a modern barbershop, and started an imports business. I care about doing honest work, treating people well, and building things that last.
